fact: Thorin opens the eastern door in the bureaucratic hub and discovers a kitchen or break room.
source_quote: The eastern door opened into a kitchen or break room
subject: kitchen exploration

fact: A gnome chef in the kitchen mistakes the party for the newly hired heroes.
source_quote: a gnome chef mistook the group for the newly hired heroes
subject: gnome chef

fact: The chef agrees to provide a snack for the party.
source_quote: The chef eventually agreed to provide a snack.
subject: snack agreement

fact: Thorin asserts that their agreement with Chief Dorbo includes board and unlimited access to the snack room.
source_quote: Thorin asserted that their agreement included board and “unlimited access to the snack room.”
subject: Thorin

fact: Thorin claims the snack room provides unlimited access as part of the party's agreement.
source_quote: unlimited access to the snack room
subject: the snack room

fact: The party jokingly describes the kitchen as a "micro kitchen."
source_quote: The party jokingly described the space as a “micro kitchen,”
subject: the kitchen

fact: Chief Dorbo directs the party to eat at the Foaming Mug because it has tables and chairs suitable for larger visitors.
source_quote: at the Foaming Mug, where there were tables and chairs suitable for larger visitors.
subject: the Foaming Mug

fact: Chief Dorbo insists the party eat elsewhere, specifically at the inn.
source_quote: Chief Dorbo then insisted that the party leave the kitchen.
subject: Chief Dorbo

fact: Chief Dorbo clarifies that Thorin's taller companions are the primary concern for table space, not Thorin himself.
source_quote: After noticing Thorin's height, he clarified that Thorin's taller companions were the real concern.
subject: Chief Dorbo

fact: The other unexplored door in the bureaucratic hub leads toward Chief Dorbo's private quarters.
source_quote: The other unexplored door led toward Chief Dorbo's private quarters.
subject: Chief Dorbo's private quarters

fact: Chief Dorbo intercepts the party near the door to his private quarters.
source_quote: Dorbo intercepted the party and dryly explained that he had no acid-resistant armor inside
subject: Chief Dorbo

fact: Chief Dorbo states his private quarters contain only a desk, a couch, and a bed.
source_quote: No, I do not have acid-resistant armor in my private quarters. I've got a desk. I've got a couch. I've got a bed.
subject: Chief Dorbo

fact: Glabbagool volunteers to squeeze through and investigate Chief Dorbo's private quarters.
source_quote: Glabbagool volunteered to squeeze through and investigate
subject: Glabbagool

fact: The party decides not to investigate Chief Dorbo's private quarters to avoid antagonizing him.
source_quote: but the party decided it was not yet time to antagonize their host that thoroughly.
subject: decision to not investigate quarters

fact: The chef asks Glabbagool if the gelatinous cube can clean the kitchen floor.
source_quote: The chef then noticed the intelligent gelatinous cube and asked whether Glabbagool could clean the kitchen floor.
subject: cleaning offer

fact: Glabbagool eagerly agrees to clean the kitchen floor.
source_quote: Glabbagool eagerly agreed.
subject: Glabbagool

fact: The chef gives Glabbagool the affectionate nickname "Roomba."
source_quote: earning the affectionate nickname “Roomba.”
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Thorin declares he will now call Glabbagool "Roomba."
source_quote: Thorin declared, “Okay, so I'm going to now call Glabbagool Roomba from now on.”
subject: naming Glabbagool

fact: The party discusses the legendary origin of gelatinous cubes as dungeon-cleaning creatures created to remove abandoned corpses and treasure between expeditions.
source_quote: a discussion of the legendary origin of gelatinous cubes as dungeon-cleaning creatures created to remove abandoned corpses and treasure between expeditions
subject: origin of gelatinous cubes

fact: Thorin identifies himself as a completionist who cannot move on from unexplored areas.
source_quote: Thorin admitted he was a completionist who could not move on while unexplored areas remained on the map.
subject: Thorin

fact: The party causes a misunderstanding by calling the chef's chicken "micro."
source_quote: prompting a misunderstanding about calling the chef's chicken “micro.”
subject: micro chicken misunderstanding
